verdict: Paid ads are delivering strong returns; two issues are being actively resolved.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads produced $6,516.48 in revenue on $1,494.33 in spend — a 4.36x return — and the last 7 days showed a sharp acceleration, with purchases up 50% and return on ad spend up 138% week over week. That momentum is real and confirmed by daily purchase data through October 7. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went quiet over the last three days, dropping to near-zero local actions after averaging roughly 21 per day prior — this is being investigated and addressed now. Several planned buildout milestones are also overdue and are being prioritized this week so the infrastructure keeps pace with the ad performance.
